subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native durable-memory provenance contract should OpenClaw use across memory-core, QMD/builtin search, MEMORY.md promotion, memory-lancedb, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but source authority, schema shape, merge/edit semantics, and cross-plugin ownership are product and architecture choices rather than a safe one-off repair.

options.title: Define native provenance contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before implementation.

options.title: Settle schema first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 to decide the canonical record and revision model first, then layer provenance onto that schema.

options.title: Keep provenance wiki-only for now
options.body: Treat Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define native provenance contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-main history across the affected memory host, citation, promotion, and Memory Wiki surfaces.
